#Hycom data

```{r}
get_hycom=function(lat_range, lon_range,n=20){
  
  url <- paste0("https://ncss.hycom.org/thredds/ncss/GLBv0.08/expt_53.X/data/2013?var=water_u&var=water_v&north=",lat_range[2]+1,"&west=",lon_range[1]-1,"&east=",lon_range[2]+1,"&south=",lat_range[1]-1,"&disableProjSubset=on&horizStride=1&time=2013-01-15T21%3A00%3A00Z&vertCoord=0.0&addLatLon=true&accept=netcdf")
  # Download the NetCDF file
  download.file(url, "hycom.nc", mode = "wb")
  
  r <- rast("hycom.nc")
  
  coords_matrix <- xyFromCell(r, 1:ncell(r))
  
  
  long=coords_matrix[,1]
  lat=coords_matrix[,2]
  velocity_u=values(r$`water_u_depth=0`)
  velocity_v=values(r$`water_v_depth=0`)
  
  hycom_df=data.frame(
    lat=lat,
    long=long,
    velocity_u=velocity_u,
    velocity_v=velocity_v
  )
  
  #gets a subset of the data set to plot
  hycom_df_filtered <- hycom_df[seq(1, nrow(hycom_df), n), ]
  
  #scales the vector size with a sigmoid function
  a=1
  hycom_df_filtered$water_u_depth.0=a*(1/(1+exp(-hycom_df_filtered$water_u_depth.0)))-(a/2)
  hycom_df_filtered$water_v_depth.0=a*(1/(1+exp(-hycom_df_filtered$water_v_depth.0)))-(a/2)
  
  return(list(r,hycom_df_filtered))
}
```

```{r}
euler_maryama_bridge=function(x0,xT,T, fun, Q, step_size,r,k=32*30,a=1){
  
  path=list(x0)
  x=c(x0[1])
  y=c(x0[2])
  path_prime=data.frame()
  f_xy=data.frame()
  times <- seq(0, T, by=step_size)
  for(i in 2:length(times)){
    #print(path[[i-1]])
    temp=fun(path[[i-1]],r)
 
    f_xy=rbind(f_xy,temp)
    # x_prime=(1/(32*60)*temp+((((xT+.001)-path[[i-1]]))/((T+.001)-times[i])))
    #x_prime=(1/(k)*temp+((((xT+.001)-path[[i-1]]))/((T+.001)-times[i])))
    #x_prime=(1/(k)*temp+((((xT)-path[[i-1]]))/((T)-times[i])))
    #x_prime=(((1/k)*((-1/T)*(times[i]-times[1])+1))*temp+((((xT)-path[[i-1]]))/((T)-times[i]))) 
     x_prime=(((1/k)*((-T**(-1/a))*((times[i]-times[1])**(1/a))+1))*temp+((((xT)-path[[i-1]]))/((T)-times[i])))
    temp =path[[i-1]]+step_size*x_prime
    path_prime=rbind(path_prime,x_prime)
    #temp =path[[i-1]]+step_size*((T-times[i]/8*T)*fun(path[[i-1]],r)+(((xT-path[[i-1]]))/(T-times[i])))

    #temp=path[[i-1]]+step_size*((xT-path[[i-1]]))/((T+.001)-i*step_size)

    
    #we need to construct a joint normal distribution and and sample form that if     #the X and y components are not independent
    
    #if they are independent then this works
    suppressWarnings({
      temp_x=rnorm(n = 1, mean = 0, sd = Q[1,1]*step_size)
      temp_y=rnorm(n = 1, mean = 0, sd = Q[2,2]*step_size)
    })
    
    temp_x=temp_x+temp[1]
    temp_y=temp_y+temp[2]
    path[[i]] = c(temp_x,temp_y)
    x[i]=path[[i]][1]
    y[i]=path[[i]][2]
  }
  colnames(f_xy)=c("f_x","f_y")
  colnames(path_prime)=c("x_prime","y_prime")
  path_df=data.frame(
    x=x[1:length(times)-1],
    y=y[1:length(times)-1]
  )
  path_df=cbind(path_df,path_prime)
  path_df=cbind(path_df,f_xy)
  return(path_df)
  }

```

#path work and path length
```{r}
h_t=function(path){
  #f(p(t))
  VF_x=c(path$f_x,path$f_y)
  a=VF_x
  #p'(t)
  b=c(path$x_prime,path$y_prime)
  #f(p(t)).p'(t)
  return(sum(a*b))
}

r_t=function(path){
  p_x=path$x_prime
  p_y=path$y_prime
  return(sqrt(p_x^2+p_y^2))
}
```

```{r}
#I need to clean this up. I am sure there is a way to make it look nice
objective <- function(k) {

  
  path=make_path(k, Q=array(c(0,0,0,0),dim=c(2,2)))
  #print(k)
  L=length(path$time)
  #print(paste0("L=",L))
  S=100
  #print(S)
  I_len=as.integer(L/S)
  #print(paste0("I_len=",I_len))
  I_len
  I_rem=L%%S
  
  objective_fun=0
  if(I_len%%2!=0){
    for(i in 1:(S-1)){
      t0=(i-1)*I_len+1
      h_t0=h_t(path[t0,])
      r_t0=r_t(path[t0,])
      
      tm=((i-1)*I_len)+as.integer(I_len/2)+1
      h_tm=h_t(path[tm,])
      r_tm=r_t(path[tm,])
      
      tf=i*I_len
      h_tf=h_t(path[tf,])
      r_tf=r_t(path[tf,])
      
      
      h_temp=((tf-t0)/6)*(h_t0+4*h_tm+h_tf)
      r_temp=((tf-t0)/6)*(r_t0+4*r_tm+r_tf)
      # temp=h_temp/r_temp
      # objective_fun=objective_fun+temp
      temp=h_temp
      objective_fun=objective_fun+temp
    }
  }else{
    for(i in 1:(S-1)){
      t0=(i-1)*I_len+1
      #print(t0)
      h_t0=h_t(path[t0,])
      r_t0=r_t(path[t0,])
      # print(h_t0)
      # print(r_t0)
      
      
      tm1=((i-1)*I_len)+I_len/2
      tm2=tm1+1
      h_tm1=h_t(path[tm1,])
      h_tm2=h_t(path[tm2,])
      r_tm1=r_t(path[tm1,])
      r_tm2=r_t(path[tm2,])
      
      h_tm=(h_tm1+h_tm2)/2
      r_tm=(r_tm1+r_tm2)/2
      # print(h_tm)
      # print(r_tm)
      
      tf=i*I_len
      h_tf=h_t(path[tf,])
      r_tf=r_t(path[tf,])
      # print(h_tf)
      # print(r_tm)
      h_temp=((tf-t0)/6)*(h_t0+4*h_tm+h_tf)
      r_temp=((tf-t0)/6)*(r_t0+4*r_tm+r_tf)
      # temp=h_temp/r_temp
      # #print(temp)
      # objective_fun=objective_fun+temp
      # print(objective_fun)
      # print("-----------")
      temp=h_temp
      objective_fun=objective_fun+temp
    }
  }
  
  t0=(S-1)*I_len+1
  h_t0=h_t(path[t0,])
  r_to=r_t(path[t0,])
  
  if(I_len+I_rem%%2!=0){    
    tm=((i-1)*I_len)+as.integer(I_len+I_rem/2)+1
    h_tm=h_t(path[tm,])
    r_tm=r_t(path[tm,])
  }else{
    tm1=((i-1)*I_len)+I_len/2
    tm2=tm1+1
    h_tm1=h_t(path[tm1,])
    h_tm2=h_t(path[tm2,])
    r_tm1=r_t(path[tm1,])
    r_tm2=r_t(path[tm2,])
      
    h_tm=(h_tm1+h_tm2)/2
    r_tm=(r_tm1+r_tm2)/2
  } 
  
    tf=(S*I_len)+I_rem
    h_tf=h_t(path[tf,])
    r_tf=r_t(path[tf,])
      
    h_temp=((tf-t0)/6)*(h_t0+4*h_tm+h_tf)
      r_temp=((tf-t0)/6)*(r_t0+4*r_tm+r_tf)
      #temp=h_temp/r_temp
      temp=h_temp
    objective_fun=objective_fun+temp
  
  #print(objective_fun)
  return(objective_fun) 
}
```

```{r}
parallel_optimizer=function(start,end){
  cl <- makeCluster(9)

  clusterExport(cl, c(
    "df_individual_trimmed",
    "euler_maryama_bridge",
    "VF_Hycom",
    "make_path",
    "h_t",
    "r_t",
    "url"
  ))
  
  clusterEvalQ(cl, {
  library(terra)
  # download.file(url, "hycom.nc", mode = "wb")
  
  r <- rast("hycom.nc")
  
  NULL
  })
  
  temp=(1/8)*(end-start)
    paths=clusterApply(cl, objective, x =list(start,1*temp+start,2*temp+start,3*temp+start,4*temp+start,5*temp+start,6*temp+start,7*temp+start,end))

  
  stopCluster(cl)
  return(paths)
}

```
